[h1][b]Frequently Asked Questions for Demo Version❓[/b][/h1]

[b]Question:[/b] Can players from different regions join the same lobby?
[b]Answer:[/b]  No. Players from different regions cannot join the same lobby. Please check your region settings before starting a game.

[b]Question:[/b] What happens if a player disconnects or leaves the game?
[b]Answer:[/b] All progress will be lost. If any player disconnects or quits, the game will end, and everyone will be returned to the main menu.

[b]Question:[/b] How many players can play the demo?
[b]Answer:[/b] The demo will support 2 players.

[b]Question:[/b] How many players are planned for the full version?
[b]Answer:[/b] We plan to expand the game to support up to 4 players.
